POPULATION EFFECTS: No meaningful subgroup differences were identified. Both phases showed poor response rates across the population. 5. CONFOUNDERS: The trial reached its planned MTD and had adequate duration (54 weeks), ruling out dose-limiting toxicity or wrong timeframe as primary factors.
